adjudications.rationale: The Long-Term Care Insurance Act distinguishes the purchase-cost benefit for specified welfare equipment in Article 44 from the in-home service benefit in Article 41, whose covered-cost clause excludes purchase of specified welfare equipment. This service is therefore outside this repository's registered delegated service-fee corpus. This determination does not cover the separate purchase-cost criteria source family.
